message.reasoning: We need to parse the logical problem. Premises: "Every sealed parcel is labeled. One parcel is not labeled." Must that parcel be unsealed? Given premises: If all sealed parcels are labeled, then any parcel that is not labeled cannot be sealed (contrapositive). So the unlabeled parcel must be unsealed. Therefore answer Yes. So option B (Yes). Need to output A or B only on final line. So B.
